name: r/bodyweightfitness Recommended Routine
author: the r/bodyweightfitness community
structure: The same full-body session three times a week: three pairs done in alternation (a pull-up and a squat progression, a dip and a hinge progression, a row and a push-up progression) for three sets of 5-8 each, then three core exercises for 3x8-12.
progression: Choose the hardest variation that allows three sets of five and add reps each session; at three sets of eight, move to the next variation and start again at five.
adapt: The pairs are supersets (`sg`). Between reviews the app adds reps, and sets once a rep ceiling (`repsMax`) is reached; moving on to the next harder variation is an exercise swap, made at a review.
caveats: The usual place to start bodyweight training. The legs run out of resistance and later need added load or a gym. Only the outline was checked, and no deload is defined.
